# `aube trust`

- **Usage:** `aube trust <SUBCOMMAND>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Inspect npm package publishing trust

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube trust check react@19.1.0
```

Read the [workflow guide](/trust-policy-exceptions) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->
